question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Shamsur Rahman, born in 1929 in Dhaka, was a poet and journalist who contributed significantly to Bangla literature. He studied English Literature at Dhaka University and was the editor of national daily Dainik Bangla and Weekly Bichitra. Rahman's poems emphasized democratic rights, social prejudices, religious deceptions, and moral eccentricity. He championed cultural movements and composed patriotic poems during the War of Liberation. Rahman authored nearly 100 books, including poems, novels, short stories, and patriotic songs.
